name: Jordan

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, white and green, with a red triangle at the hoist containing a small white seven-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: The stripes recall the Abbasid (black), Umayyad (white) and Fatimid (green) caliphates and the red triangle the Hashemite dynasty; the star's seven points represent the seven verses of the first chapter of the Quran.

hook: Jordan is Palestine's flag plus a small white seven-pointed star in the red triangle; Sudan's triangle is green and its stripes start with red.
trivia: The design is based on the flag of the Arab Revolt of 1916 against Ottoman rule.
